{{Quote|Please ''take a seat'', General. Factory master Quingarus will be with you ''shortly''.|The protocol droid, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Foreclosure" />}}
This '''protocol droid''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that served at the [[Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] factory located on a [[Unidentified planet (Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory)|planet]] close to the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this protocol droid welcomed [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] upon his arrival on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
